name: SSHI-FBR
rationale: Combine a Full-Bridge Rectifier (FBR) with a Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit to increase the harvested energy and a Zener clamp to prevent overvoltage in S3. The SSHI inversion flips the piezo capacitance voltage at the extrema, reducing the impact of diode drops and improving vavg and tup for weak excitations (S4) and heavy loads (S2). The Zener clamp ensures vmax <= 3.6V.
